sentences.en: You will describehealth problems and healthy lifestyles.

sentences.en: You will read andidentify a student's problem and its solution in a story.

sentences.en: You will writesuggestions to help friends with their problems.

sentences.en: 📌 1. Liu Jia had a runny nose and felt unhappy. ( F )
sentences.zh: 📌 1. 刘佳流鼻涕并且感到不开心。（F）

sentences.en: ✗ Wrong: Liu Jia was crying and feeling down — not having a runny nose.
sentences.zh: ✗ 错误：原文是她在哭泣，心情低落，并非流鼻涕。

sentences.en: 📌 2. Liu Jia shared her feelings with Miss White. ( T )
sentences.zh: 📌 2. 刘佳与怀特老师分享了她的感受。（T）

sentences.en: 📌 3. Liu Jia often makes video calls with her friend now. ( T )
sentences.zh: 📌 3. 刘佳现在经常与她的朋友进行视频通话。（T）

sentences.en: 📌 4. Liu Jia called Miss White and thanked her. ( F )
sentences.zh: 📌 4. 刘佳打电话给怀特老师并向她道谢。（F）

sentences.en: ✗ Wrong: Liu Jia wrote a letter to thank Miss White — not a phone call.
sentences.zh: ✗ 错误：刘佳是写信感谢的，而非打电话。

sentences.en: Mike and Chen Jie are in the playground. Listen and write T (True) or F (False). 🎧
sentences.zh: 迈克（Mike）和陈洁在操场上。听录音，写T（正确）或F（错误）。🎧

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: Hi, Mike. It's Binbin. I'm going to the science museum tomorrow. Are you coming?
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：嗨，迈克（Mike）。我是彬彬（Binbin）。我明天要去科学博物馆。你来吗？

sentences.en: 📞👦 Mike: I'm afraid not, Binbin. I have a bad cold.
sentences.zh: 📞👦 迈克（Mike）：恐怕不行，彬彬（Binbin）。我得了重感冒。

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: Oh dear! How do you feel?
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：哦，不！你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: 📞👦 Mike: I feel ill. My head hurts and I have a runny nose.
sentences.zh: 📞👦 迈克（Mike）：我感觉不舒服。我头痛而且流鼻涕。

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you should see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：听到这个我很遗憾。也许你应该去看医生。

sentences.en: 📞👦 Mike: I know. My mum is going to take me to hospital this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 📞👦 迈克（Mike）：我知道。我妈妈今天下午要带我去医院。

sentences.en: 📞🧒 Binbin: That's good. Take care and get well soon!
sentences.zh: 📞🧒 彬彬（Binbin）：那很好。保重，祝你早日康复！

sentences.en: Take a deep breath when you feel sad.
sentences.zh: 当你感到伤心时做一个深呼吸。

sentences.en: Talk to your friends or family.
sentences.zh: 和你的朋友或家人聊聊天。

sentences.en: 🤝 Be friendly with people around you
Help others when they need you.
sentences.zh: 在别人需要你的时候帮助他们。

迈克）has a bad cold. His head hurts and he has a runny nose.
🧒🤧 迈克（Mike）得了重感冒。他头痛而且流鼻涕。

sentences.en: 🤒 I have a bad cold. And I have a runny nose.
sentences.zh: 🤒 我得了重感冒。而且我流鼻涕。

sentences.en: 🖐️✋ 1. My name is Right Hand. This is my twin brother, Left Hand.
sentences.zh: 🖐️✋ 1. 我的名字叫右手（Right Hand）。这是我的双胞胎兄弟，左手（Left Hand）。

sentences.en: 🧒🍎 2. One day, our master didn't wash us and ate his food. He felt ill the next day. Now he washes us before every meal.
sentences.zh: 🧒🍎 2. 有一天，我们的主人没有洗手就吃东西了。他第二天感觉不舒服。现在他每次吃饭前都会洗手。

sentences.en: 🤧🧴 3. On another day, our master had a bad cold. He had a runny nose and a cough. We wiped his nose and covered his mouth with a tissue. We're important for his physical health.
sentences.zh: 🤧🧴 3. 又有一天，我们的主人得了重感冒。他流鼻涕还咳嗽。我们帮他擦鼻子，并用纸巾捂住他的嘴巴。我们对他的身体健康很重要。

sentences.en: 🎨📚 4. We're also important for his mental and social health. One day, our master felt unhappy. But we helped him make handicrafts. He felt happy again.
sentences.zh: 🎨📚 4. 我们对他的心理健康和社交健康也很重要。有一天，我们的主人感到不开心。但我们帮助他制作了手工艺品。他又开心起来了。

sentences.en: 2️⃣ Later, people used different forms of money. But what did the money look like? Look! There is shell money, knife money, copper coins, ...
sentences.zh: 2️⃣ 后来，人们使用了不同形式的货币。但是这些货币长什么样呢？看！有贝壳货币、刀币、铜钱……

sentences.en: 3️⃣ metal coins 金属货币 50 kilos of coins = a roll of silk
sentences.zh: 3️⃣ 金属货币 50公斤的金属货币 = 一匹丝绸

sentences.en: But metal coins were heavy to carry. So people used paper money.
sentences.zh: 但是金属货币携带起来很重。所以人们开始使用纸币。

sentences.en: 4️⃣ We still use paper money today. We also have bankbooks and cards.
sentences.zh: 4️⃣ 我们今天仍然在使用纸币。我们还有存折和银行卡。
🅰️ 我们为什么要使用金钱？

sentences.en: Mum is giving Matt his pocket money. Listen and write T (True) or F (False). 🎧
sentences.zh: 妈妈正在给马特零花钱。听录音，写T或F。🎧

sentences.en: Matt gets 25 yuan for his piggy bank. （ ）
sentences.zh: 马特得到了25元放入存钱罐。（ ）

sentences.en: Matt is going to buy some pencils. （ ）
👦 Mike: Are you counting your pocket money, Matt?
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：马特，你在数你的零花钱吗？

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: Yes. I have three hundred and fifty-seven yuan.
sentences.zh: 👦 马特：是的。我有三百五十七元。

sentences.en: 👦 Mike: Wow, that's a lot. How are you going to spend it?
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：哇，好多啊。你打算怎么花这些钱？

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: I'm going to buy a schoolbag.
sentences.zh: 👦 马特：我打算买一个书包。

sentences.en: 👦 Mike: Yes, you need a new one.
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：是的，你需要一个新的。

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: I also want to buy some books.
👦 Mike: Nice. Maybe you can buy some animal books. They're interesting.
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：不错。也许你可以买一些动物类的书，很有趣的。

sentences.en: 👦 Matt: Great idea! I like animals. Should I also buy some ice cream?
sentences.zh: 👦 马特：好主意！我喜欢动物。我也应该买一些冰淇淋吗？

sentences.en: 👦 Mike: Sure, but don't eat too much.
sentences.zh: 👦 迈克：当然可以，但是不要吃太多。
👦 马特：你说得对。我不会的。

sentences.zh: 莎拉正在和她的妈妈交谈。听录音并回答问题。🎧

sentences.en: What is Sarah going to buy?
👩 Mum: How much pocket money do you have?
👧 Sarah: I have one hundred and forty-six yuan.
sentences.zh: 👧 莎拉：我有一百四十六元。

sentences.en: 👩 Mum: What else are you going to buy?
👧 Sarah: A lot. But first I'm going to buy a pair of sunglasses for Grandpa.
sentences.zh: 👧 莎拉：很多东西。但首先我打算给爷爷买一副太阳眼镜。

sentences.en: 👧 Sarah: Because he lost his old pair last weekend.
sentences.zh: 👧 莎拉：因为他上周末把旧的那副弄丢了。

sentences.en: 👩 Mum: That's so nice of you!
👧 Sarah: I also want to buy a microscope.
sentences.zh: 👧 莎拉：我还想买一台显微镜。

sentences.en: 👩 Mum: Good idea! But microscopes are expensive.
sentences.zh: 👩 妈妈：好主意！但是显微镜很贵。

sentences.en: 👧 Sarah: I also have some lucky money from the Spring Festival, but I still need to save more.
sentences.zh: 👧 莎拉：我还有一些春节压岁钱，但我仍然需要多存一些。

sentences.en: 👩 Mum: Maybe we can wait for a sale!
sentences.zh: 👩 妈妈：也许我们可以等打折的时候再买！
